text:
maya: Heads-up — we need to spin up a fresh prompt sampling run for the atlas-quant model bring-up. Goal: 10k eval samples, ~1k golden for manual review. Need dedupe rules and labeling queue ownership.
pranav: +1. Are we stratifying by prompt type and length? last time short prompts biased the quant metrics.
sasha: yes stratify by bucket: chat, instruction, code, multistep; also by token length (<=32, 33-128, 129+). keep same sampling weights as prod traffic for cost comparability.
jon: For dedupe, can we run a two-stage pass: exact fingerprint then fuzzy-match on normalized text? happy to share a small script.
maya: exact then fuzzy sounds right. we should also exclude any prompts used in the last 6 months of evals + golden sets.
pranav: here's a quick dedupe SQL + fuzzy pipeline we used previously:
```
-- exact fingerprint filter
SELECT * FROM prompts
WHERE fingerprint NOT IN (SELECT fingerprint FROM eval_runs WHERE run_date > '2025-09-01');

-- fuzzy: compute normalized trigram hash and drop near-duplicates (threshold 0.85)
```
jon: + code note: use `simhash` for a cheap pass then `levenstein` on the candidates. that keeps costs down.
label-bot: @maya created queue `atlas-quant-1k-golden` (size=1000) and `atlas-quant-10k-sample` (size=10000). Owners: @sasha for stratification, @jon for dedupe.
maya: thanks @label-bot. sasha — can you own the weighting spec? need a doc by EOD tomorrow to hand to sampling infra.
sasha: will do. quick Q: do we want to oversample edge-case tags (api-instructions, hallucination-prone prompts)?
pranav: yes oversample by 2x for those tags so eval has power to detect regressions. document that as a separate cohort.
jon: dedupe note — when fuzzy matching across languages, normalize unicode NFKC and lower-case. for code snippets, keep whitespace normalized but preserve punctuation.
maya: good call. also we must mark any prompt with customer PII and send them to private-only queue (no external reviewers). ops-bot: flagged: add policy `pii:private-only` to sampling job.
pranav: labeling SLA? golden review needs 2 reviewers min, adjudication by senior annotator. assume 72h for 1k golden.
sasha: I can allocate 4 labelers + 1 senior for the golden batch to hit ~48h. will confirm on headcount.
jon: For quant bench, we also need token-length distribution histograms attached to the run so we can compare pre/post quant. can infra add those to the run metadata?
ops-bot: @jon created ticket INFRA-4892: "attach token-length and token-cost histograms to eval runs". ETA: 3 business days.
maya: timeline: sampling + dedupe scripts by Tue, sampling job Wed, golden labeling Thu-Fri, bench run next Monday. does that work?
pranav: sounds tight but doable. if infra ETA slips we can parallelize by starting non-golden 9k sample run earlier.
sasha: I'll draft the weighting table and edge-cohort definitions now and post link when done.
jon: I'll drop the dedupe notebook in the shared drive: `s3://rwi-eng/dedup/atlas-quant/notebooks/dedup_v2.ipynb`
maya: perfect. last ask — include a small promptset of adversarial examples (1000) we keep frozen across model rollouts to catch regressions. add to golden as a separate tag.
sasha: noted, will add `adversarial-frozen` tag.
label-bot: queue `atlas-quant-1k-golden` updated: tags=["edge-cohort","adversarial-frozen","pii:private-only"]. Owners updated.
pranav: can we include a short eval checklist for labelers? things to check: instructions followed, hallucination, refusal quality, sensitive content.
sasha: will append checklist to the queue.
maya: thanks everyone — I'll follow up after the weighting doc. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :rocket:
